    ci: check the commits of each pull request with commitlint
    
    The commitlint job runs commitlint.config.js over the commits between
    the base and the head of the pull request. Unlike a commit-msg hook,
    git commit --no-verify cannot skip it, so the rule applies to everyone,
    pi included. knip now sees @commitlint/cli in use, so drop it from
    ignoreDependencies.
    
    Refs #38
